body:
Founder real-time: 'continue rewriting MISHRI using parena using parena mods'. Extended src/emit_ts.c's recognized external-primitive support from a single hardcoded math/random case to a real, table-driven MATH_PRIM_TABLE (random/floor/sqrt/log/cos) + a real math/pi constant. Renamed/grew stdlib/math/random.prn -> stdlib/math/math.prn. New stdlib/mishri/humanness.prn: real ports of chance/randInt/addNoise (Box-Muller), addNoise's own u1/u2 bindings collapsed into two inline (math/random) calls, zero let needed. 7 new emitter tests (21 total). Real, verified proof: compiled to MISHRI/src/generated/humanness.ts, wired into MISHRI's live HumannessLayer.ts, verified bit-for-bit identical against the originals across ~390 cases with Math.random() mocked deterministically -- zero mismatches, MISHRI's own 84-assertion suite still passes. STDLIB.md updated with honest status (4 real functions built now: bezier-interp, chance, random-int, gaussian-noise; async/map blockers for the rest of mishri/humanness still explicitly unresolved). PARENA commits 768e1f6/ee575d5, MISHRI commits 97d4de1/1b0de2d.

⚓ ☃
title: Math primitive table grown, chance/randInt/addNoise ported and verified
